dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline fitted to the posterior margin showing progressive curvature from the apex to the basal insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a moderate pixel radius; classified as non-acute and obtuse.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep linear margin at approximately 55 degrees relative to the horizontal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Base-to-height ratio approximately 1.25:1, characterized by a wide basal foundation relative to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent V-shaped notch located on the lower third of the trailing edge; secondary micro-notching along the upper trailing edge; multiple superficial white linear scratches and punctate scars visible on the lateral fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive distribution of small, white, circular punctate spots (speckling) across the visible integument of the dorsal fin and back.
